title: Code and data for the computational screening of fluorinated oxetane and oxane solvents for sodium electrolytes
description: Scripts, result tables and figures for the DFT-based screening of 134 methylated and fluorinated oxetanes and oxanes (tetrahydropyrans) as solvents for low-temperature sodium electrolytes: Na+ binding energies, electrostatic-potential descriptors, ring-strain release energies, dipole moments, proton affinities, frontier-orbital energies and Pareto analysis.
